NewsArticle.Title: Service Interruption
NewsArticle.Content: Dark Ages is available now. The internet connection error is now fixed. Dark Ages was offline this afternoon. We were greatly frustrated to watch our world run, but have no players to play in it. There was an internet error that prevented players from entering the world for a few hours. The day is free, on us. Your registered account has been credited. We'll do all things in our power to ensure Dark Ages is connected all the time. Dark Ages servers are fast and stable; running well below maximum load with 0 server lag at peak volume. If you do experience latency, test your connection ( [http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm](http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm) ).
